description: The bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R (%) performance of three different models—LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B—under various SFT (Supervised Fine-Tuning) conditions. The horizontal axis lists the models, while the vertical axis represents the CoLeG-R (%) score, ranging from 0 to 80. Each model has four bars corresponding to different SFT settings: '+ SFT on D₀' (light blue), '+ SFT on D₀, D₁' (light orange), '+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂' (light purple), and a fourth condition (light pink) that is only present for LLaMA-2-7B and LLaMA-2-13B. For LLaMA-2-7B, the performance increases from approximately 67% with '+ SFT on D₀' to about 84% with the fourth condition. For LLaMA-2-13B, the performance ranges from around 70% to 85%. For LLaMA-2-70B, the performance is consistently high, starting at about 81% with '+ SFT on D₀' and reaching approximately 84% with the fourth condition. The chart indicates that larger models generally achieve higher CoLeG-R scores, and the performance improves with the addition of more diverse training data (D₀, D₁, D₂) across all models.
